title: Marvell buys Inphi for about $10B

sources.quote: Recent Developments On October 29, 2020, we entered into a merger agreement (the “Merger Agreement”) with Inphi Corporation (“Inphi”), whereby we will pay Inphi's stockholders $66 per share in cash and 2.323 common shares for each Inphi share, which represented purchase consideration of approximately $10 billion as of that date.

explain: Marvell bought Inphi, a maker of high-speed optical connection chips used inside data centers, for about $10B in cash and stock; the deal closed in April 2021. Those chips now carry much of the data between AI servers.
